changelog:
Initial release of Bilibili video search and download skill.

- Search Bilibili videos by keyword and retrieve metadata including title, author, play count, duration, and BV号.
- Download Bilibili videos using yt-dlp, with support for best quality selection, audio/video merging, and metadata embedding.
- Saves search results to a JSON file (search.json) with structured video data.
- Provides robust environment checks for Python, virtual environments, dependencies, and Bilibili API/network accessibility.
- Handles Bilibili anthology videos, download verification, and authentication for higher quality downloads.
- Includes detailed instructions and troubleshooting for common setup and usage issues.
